clauses.reason: The lead clause recites the authority and directs that Executive Order 12369 be amended as follows; it increases the membership and extends the life of the President’s Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government. It is the instruction that carries subsections (a) and (b). Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 orders that the listed Executive Orders, "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" and lists the number 12398 in the No. column of its revocation table (offset 26972 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt). This is an express revocation that names this order. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1986-02-25; that is a reading of the text, not express wording, and the Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates. Executive Order 12534 (signed 1985-09-30, effective 1985-09-30 by its section 5, held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt) revokes the parent Executive Order 12369, (b) Executive Order No. 12369 establishing the President’s Private Sector Survey on Cost Control in the Federal Government, reciting committees that have terminated or been abolished by statute or whose work is completed; it names the parent order but not this amending order, so under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments it is disclosed as an earlier candidate and not adopted as the end.

Subsection (a) restates the second sentence of section 1(a) of EO 12369 to provide that the Committee is composed of not more than 170 members appointed by the President from among citizens in private life. No later held order amends this subsection. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 orders that the listed Executive Orders, "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" and lists the number 12398 in the No. column of its revocation table (offset 26972 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt). This is an express revocation that names this order. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1986-02-25; that is a reading of the text, not express wording, and the Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates.

Subsection (b) restates section 4(b) of EO 12369 so that "the Committee shall terminate on June 30, 1983, unless" sooner extended. Later amendments of the same sentence are later events that change the date and do not end the clause: EO 12429 (signed 1983-06-28) substitutes 1983-10-30, EO 12447 (signed 1983-10-27) substitutes 1983-12-31 and EO 12455 (signed 1983-12-29) substitutes 1984-01-31, each as a rewrite of the whole sentence that changes its substance (the date) while the clause continues, amended, until the order ends. EO 12398 (signed 1982-12-31; 48 FR 377) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12398.txt. It amends Executive Order 12369 (President’s Private Sector Survey on Cost Control): the lead recital and instruction, subsection (a) (membership of not more than 170) and subsection (b) (Committee terminates on 1983-06-30 unless sooner extended). The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12398>EO:12553 (agent-located, independently reviewed) was re-read against the held EO 12553 text, whose revocation table lists 12398. Later orders read in their held Federal Register texts: EO 12429 (signed 1983-06-28) restates section 4(b) with the date 1983-10-30; EO 12447 (signed 1983-10-27) with 1983-12-31; EO 12455 (signed 1983-12-29) with 1984-01-31, each unless sooner extended. EO 12534 (1985-09-30) revokes the parent EO 12369 without naming EO 12398. Machine searches read: U.S. Code 0 hits, eCFR 0 hits, Federal Register catalog hits not decisive. Under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments and strike-and-insert) and 2026-10-28 the end is EO 12553, the amendments of section 4(b) are later events recorded in the reasons, and the parent revocation and the last held scheduled sunset are disclosed candidates.
